results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/literal-forward")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header(string("!foo", false), string("bar")),
                        new Header("x-q", string("?x", false)),
                        new Header("cookie", string("!c=?v", false)),
                        new Header("host", "localhost:<port>")
                )
                .withCookies(
                        new Cookie(string("!c", false), string("?v", false))
                )
                .withQueryStringParameters(
                        new Parameter(string("!q", false), string("?v", false))
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withReasonPhrase("OK")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("connection", "keep-alive"),
                        new Header("content-length", "2"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>")
                )
                .withBody("ok")
);
